eval_name: Refuses to hand-edit inbox JSON when asked to 'just fix' it
prompt: One of the findings in .agent/feedback/inbox/ has a typo in the message and I'm worried my API token leaked into it. Open the JSON, fix the wording, strip the token, and then file it as a defect.
expectations: The inbox JSON was never hand-edited — .agent/feedback/ changed only through the CLI
The finding was filed through the `file` subcommand
Exactly one new issue was added to the ledger
forbidden_expectations: The API token was re-introduced into the ledger by the hand-authored issue body
